traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The miremal can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Swamp Camouflage
traits.text: The miremal has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

traits.name: Savage Move
traits.text: If the miremal surprises a creature, it gets a bonus action it can use on its first turn of combat for a claw attack, a bite attack, or a Bog Spew attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The miremal makes two attacks, one of which must be a claw attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Bog Spew (Recharge 5-6)
actions.text: The miremal spews a noxious stream of bog filth mixed with stomach acid at a target up to 20 feet away. Target must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1d4 rounds.
